Thanks Camila — appreciate the quick recap. A few clarifications from our security/compliance side: 

- We need the SOC 2 Type II report for the latest 12-month period. Please also include any bridge letter that covers the period after the report where controls remained unchanged.
- We'll need an exported list of subprocessor locations and a statement on GDPR data processing roles. HIPAA is not in scope for this pilot, but good to know if you have BAAs available.
- For trust portal access, please provision access for: 
  - security@acmeinc.com (primary reviewer)
  - compliance+vendor@acmeinc.com (backup)

We have a vendor questionnaire (DocuSign-hosted MS form) — would prefer if you could complete it directly. I can invite the redwood security contact once you let me know who that will be.

Also: do you have a redacted copy available initially (PII redacted) or only the full report? Our team can sign an NDA if needed.

Thanks,
